The '''Rontzken Mountain Chronicles''' are an epic or chronicle tradition associated with [[Rontzken]]-speaking highland and mining communities.

The extracted source says the chronicles preserve mining history, mountain warfare, and the relationship between highland peoples and the wider Rhovlandian federal government. They are important because they show that Rhovlandian political identity includes regional memory from mountains and mining districts, not only central administration in St. Blane.

== Draft Scope ==

This page preserves the source-attested tradition without inventing named cycles, heroic figures, battles, manuscripts, or canon performance dates.
